args.title: Support additional currency symbols and thousands separators in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to strip additional currency symbols like the rupee sign (₹) and handle apostrophes used as thousands separators (such as in CHF 1'200.00), so that these values parse correctly.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function parseAmount currently strips only spaces, €, $, £, and ¥, causing values with other currency symbols like ₹ or apostrophes used as thousands separators in CHF to fail parsing. Updating the currency stripping and character cleaning logic in src/util/money.ts will resolve these parsing failures.
